verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows self-hosting via Docker Compose and multiple product/agent features, plus a coding-agent 'sandboxed environment' for making code edits, but there is no documented sandbox/staging PostHog project, test API key mode, or any mechanism to test AI-agent actions (flags, experiments, SQL) against non-production data. Missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/staging environment feature, test-mode API keys, or explicit guidance on isolating AI testing from production analytics data.
